scope: Bounded code-blind PRD producer execution. Read each isolated PRD, persist a final fenced verdict, then parse and consume it through the actual prd-readiness CLI. Separate policy decisions; no run mint, full orchestration, code inspection or tracker mutation.

rule_cases.question: May the producer inspect a plausible implementation to rescue a vague PRD? Return a boolean.
Can tight creative licence by itself make verifiable stop conditions not-ready? Return a boolean.
A PRD has one verifiable condition and two vague criteria. Is the verifiability minimum met? Return a boolean.
A malformed or absent verdict block should admit the run. Return a boolean.
Return the sole deterministic validator command as a JSON string.
Must exactly one prd-readiness fenced block be last in the producer output? Return a boolean.
Return the safe verdict on doubt as a JSON string.
Return the reason value required with admissible as a JSON string.
